Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Dian.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Diane
Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Dian.make_ahead: Prep the mushrooms and shallot up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the steaks and the stock sauce to order

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Bat out the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in the vegetable oil in a very hot pan, then rest on a plate.
In the same pan melt the butter and fry the mushrooms and shallot.
Add the beef stock and let it bubble down, then add the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer.
Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve with the fries and watercress.
Slice the jam rollette and line a large glass bowl. Drizzle with the orange juice.
Scatter over the raspberries and pour over the custard.
Chill until the custard firms up.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks and spread over the top.
Lay strawberries in a cross and diagonals, then fill the gaps with blueberries to make a Union Jack.

Groovy baby gin martini.make_ahead: Freeze the glasses up to 1 day ahead and chill the non-alcoholic gin in the fridge; stir with ice to serve

steps.text: Chill the martini glasses in the freezer.
Fill a jug with ice, add the non-alcoholic gin, verjuice and a teaspoon of brine from the olive jar and stir steadily until very cold.
Strain into the glasses. Twist a strip of lemon zest over each, or add an olive on a pick.

Normandy beach mussels.make_ahead: Chop the eschalots and garlic up to 1 day ahead and mix the stock and verjuice; steam the mussels to order

steps.text: Chop the eschalots and garlic.
Soften in some butter in a big pot.
Add the mussels, fish stock and verjuice, cover and steam until open.
Toss through chopped parsley and a knob of butter.
Serve with crusty bread to mop up.

Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream.n: Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream
Angel of Verdun chicken, cider and cream.make_ahead: Simmer the chicken in the apple juice, stock and vinegar up to 2 days ahead; reheat, then add the cream and parsley on the night

steps.text: Season the chicken.
Brown in butter, 4 minutes a side, then set aside.
Soften the eschalots and mushrooms in the pan.
Pour in the apple juice, stock and vinegar and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer.
Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.

Gunfire: army tea with dark rum.n: Gunfire: army tea with dark rum (alcohol-free)
Gunfire: army tea with dark rum.make_ahead: Best brewed fresh and hot; mix the sugar, molasses, vanilla and nutmeg in the mugs up to 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Warm a big teapot with boiling water and tip it out.
Add the tea bags and freshly boiled water and leave to stew until properly strong.
Put the sugar, a little molasses, a few drops of vanilla and the nutmeg into each of four metal mugs.
Pour in the tea, add a splash of milk and stir well.

Beer-battered Tassie chips.make_ahead: Parboil and steam dry the chips up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, and mix the dipping mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead; batter and fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and parboil, then drain and steam dry
Whisk the flour with the cold alcohol-free beer and salt
Dip the chips in the batter
Fry in batches in the oil at 180C until golden
Drain and toss with chicken salt
Mix the mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice for dipping

Apple cider pork.make_ahead: Cook the pork in the apple juice up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; boil and mash the potatoes fresh

steps.text: Brown the chops in oil and set aside
Soften the onion and apples with sage
Pour in the apple juice and vinegar, return the chops and simmer until the sauce reduces
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter

E=mc2 lager and cider snakebite.make_ahead: Nothing to cook; chill the apple juice, alcohol-free lager and pint glasses up to 1 day ahead and build each glass just before serving

steps.text: Chill four pint glasses in the freezer
Add cordial to each glass
Pour in the sparkling apple juice down the side, then top slowly with alcohol-free lager so it layers and foams
Serve straight away

Waco Kid's whiskey nuts.make_ahead: Up to 5 days in a tin

steps.text: Melt the butter with the sugar, paprika and vanilla.
Toss with the peanuts and pecans on a tray.
Roast at 160C, stirring once.
Cool on the tray.

Saloon sarsaparilla spider float.make_ahead: Chill the sarsaparilla up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; scoop, pour and twist the orange zest just before serving

steps.text: Chill the sarsaparilla.
Put a big scoop of ice cream into each of four tall glasses.
Pour the sarsaparilla slowly down the side so it foams up over the ice cream.
Twist a strip of orange zest over each. Serve with long spoons and straws.

Wade and Vanessa's steak frites.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and hold them in cold water; roast, sear the steaks and reduce the stock sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast until crisp.
Sear the steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest.
Add the stock and vinegar to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Slice the steak and serve by candlelight.

Cable's cold brew espresso martini.make_ahead: Chill the glasses in the freezer up to 1 day ahead; shake each drink to order with the cold brew, kept chilled up to 3 days

steps.text: Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer.
For each drink, measure 90ml cold brew coffee, 15ml sugar syrup and a couple of drops of vanilla into a shaker.
Shake each drink very hard with plenty of ice for 15 seconds so it foams, then strain into the glass.
Float three coffee beans on top of each. Make it in batches of one or two.

Chili Palmer's steak frites.make_ahead: Make the sauce while the steak rests; fry the chips twice

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites and fry in the neutral oil at 140C for 5 minutes, then rest.
Season the steaks and sear hard for 3 minutes a side, then rest.
Sweat the shallots in the pan fat, add the stock and vinegar and reduce by two thirds, then whisk in the butter.
Fry the frites again in the oil at 185C until crisp.
Slice the steak and spoon the sauce over.

Look-at-me Bloody Mary.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, lemon juice, horseradish and seasonings up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; shake with ice to order

ingredients.item: celery salt and pepper, to taste

steps.text: Put a share of tomato juice, lemon, horseradish, Worcestershire, hot sauce, celery salt and pepper in a tin with ice.
Pour back and forth between two tins 5 times.
Strain over fresh ice and add a celery stick. Repeat for each drink.

Christmas plum pudding with brandy custa.n: Christmas plum pudding with brandy custard
Christmas plum pudding with brandy custa.make_ahead: Steam the pudding up to 2 days ahead and reheat to serve; make the orange custard up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and rewarm gently

steps.text: Steam the pudding in its basin over simmering water, or follow the packet.
Warm the milk and cream until steaming.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar and cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it thickens, then stir in the orange zest and vanilla.
Turn out the pudding and pour over the custard.

Connecticut inn hot buttered rum cider.n: Connecticut inn hot buttered rum cider (alcohol-free)
Connecticut inn hot buttered rum cider.make_ahead: Simmer and strain the spiced apple juice up to 2 days ahead and mash the spiced butter up to 3 days ahead; reheat to serve

steps.text: Simmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and ginger without boiling.
Mash the butter with the sugar, molasses, vanilla and nutmeg.
Strain the spiced apple juice into mugs and drop in a teaspoon of spiced butter to melt on top.

Paris steak frites.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks overnight.
Cut the potatoes thin and fry in the vegetable oil at 140C, drain, then fry at 185C until crisp.
Sear the steaks hard in cast iron, pull at 54C and rest.
Crush the peppercorns in the pan, add the stock and let it bubble, then add the cream and reduce until it coats a spoon.
Finish with the butter and serve.

Sacré-Cœur steps cognac sidecar.make_ahead: Steep and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and juice the lemons the day before; shake to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then lift out and cool the tea over a few cubes of ice.
Chill four coupes. Rub the rims with lemon and dip in sugar.
Shake the cold tea, orange juice, fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and a drop of vanilla hard with ice for 15 seconds, one drink at a time.
Strain into the coupes and twist orange peel over the top.

Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip.n: Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip
Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip.make_ahead: Mash the dip with the alcohol-free beer up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; shape and bake the pretzels fresh

steps.text: Roll the dough into ropes and twist into pretzels.
Dip each in simmering water with the bicarb briefly.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C.
Mash the camembert with the butter, cream cheese, alcohol-free beer, paprika, caraway and onion.
Serve the pretzels warm with the dip and cornichons.

Omi's apple glühwein.make_ahead: Warm the juices with the tea and spices, then cool and keep chilled up to 2 days ahead; reheat gently to serve

steps.text: Pour the grape juice and apple juice into a saucepan with the tea bag, sugar, spices and half the orange slices.
Heat gently without letting it simmer, lifting out the tea bag after 5 minutes.
Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each.
Cube the sponge and press into a glass bowl, then splash with orange juice.
Make up the jelly and pour over the sponge.
Chill until set.
Spoon over the custard and top with whipped cream.
Chill overnight and top with raspberries.

Mulled wine.make_ahead: Make it up to 2 days ahead, remove the tea bag and keep covered in the fridge; reheat gently without boiling

steps.text: Slice the orange.
Warm the grape juice with the orange, cinnamon, cloves, honey and tea bag gently without boiling, lifting out the tea bag after 5 minutes.
Ladle into mugs.

Risotto alla milanese.make_ahead: Dice the onion and grate the parmesan up to 1 day ahead, and steep the saffron in a little hot stock up to 2 hours ahead; cook the risotto just before serving

steps.text: Soften the diced onion in some of the butter.
Add the rice and toast, then add the verjuice.
Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, with the saffron steeped in, stirring.
Finish with the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

Orange spritz.make_ahead: Chill the orange aperitif and alcohol-free sparkling wine up to 1 day ahead; slice the orange and build in glasses over ice to serve

steps.text: Fill four big wine glasses with ice.
Add the orange aperitif, sparkling wine and a splash of soda water.
Add an orange slice.

Pub pie and chips.make_ahead: Braise the beef and alcohol-free ale filling up to 2 days ahead and chill it; cover with pastry and bake on the day, and fry the chips to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onions
Stir in the flour first, then add the alcohol-free ale and stock, cover and braise at 160C
Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish and cover with puff pastry
Bake at 200C
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil
Cook and crush the peas

Pint at the Winchester.make_ahead: Chill the cans or bottles for at least 3 hours

steps.text: Chill the alcohol-free ale and lager in the fridge for at least 3 hours.
Pour the ale, or the lager for anyone who prefers it, into pint glasses at a tilt so the head settles, and raise them to the Winchester.
Simmer the shallots with the grape juice and vinegar until almost dry. Cool, then mix into the butter with the salt and chill.
Cut the potatoes into frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Salt lightly.
Season the steaks and sear hard in a hot pan with the oil to your preferred doneness.
Rest the steaks, then slice and top with the shallot butter. Serve with frites.

Election night French 75.make_ahead: Make and cool the syrup up to 1 week ahead in the fridge; shake and top with sparkling wine just before serving

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, lemon juice and cooled syrup with ice.
Strain evenly into 4 chilled flutes and top each with sparkling wine, pouring slowly.
Finish with a long strip of lemon peel.

Beef sausages with beer onions.make_ahead: Cook the onions with the alcohol-free beer up to 3 days ahead and keep them in the fridge; reheat while the sausages grill

steps.text: Slowly cook the sliced onions in the butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the brown sugar, the balsamic and the alcohol-free beer and simmer 5 minutes until jammy.
Grill the thick beef sausages on a medium barbecue for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Butter the slices of white bread, wrap each round a sausage and top with the onion relish, mustard and tomato sauce.

Jean-Claude's Bondi fish and chips.make_ahead: Best fried just before serving; chop the pickles and mix the tartare up to 2 days ahead in the fridge

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry in the oil at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the cold alcohol-free beer into a batter, dip the flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.

Rosehill Cottage Welsh rarebit.make_ahead: Make the cheese mixture up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; spread on toast and grill on the night

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the alcohol-free beer.
Add the cheddar, mustard and Worcestershire and stir over low heat until thick and smooth.
Toast the sourdough.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly to the edges and grill until bubbling and browned in spots.
Cut in half and serve hot.

Cottage mulled wine.make_ahead: Slice the orange and measure out the spices up to 1 day ahead; warm everything together on the night

steps.text: Pour the grape juice into a pot with the tea bag, sliced orange, cinnamon, cloves, star anise and honey.
Warm gently, never letting it boil, and lift out the tea bag after 5 minutes.
Ladle into mugs by the fire.
Salt the steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Sear hard in a hot pan.
Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then rest the steaks.
Add the stock and vinegar to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Slice the steak and pour over the sauce.

Red pill or blue pill gin fizz.n: Red pill or blue pill gin fizz (alcohol-free)
Red pill or blue pill gin fizz.make_ahead: Two red and two blue, choose carefully

steps.text: For the red drinks, shake half the non-alcoholic gin with half the lemon juice, the raspberry syrup and cranberry juice with ice and strain into two ice-filled glasses.
For the blue drinks, shake the rest of the gin and lemon juice with the blue curacao syrup and sugar syrup and strain into two ice-filled glasses.
Top all four with soda water and add a lemon wheel.

Beach volleyball fish tacos.make_ahead: Slaw and salsa up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Whisk the flour with the alcohol-free beer into a batter. Mix the sour cream with lime juice.
Dice the tomato and onion and shred the cabbage.
Dip the fish in batter and fry in the oil at 180C for 3 minutes, in batches, until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, tomato, onion and the lime cream.

Iceman's frozen lemon lager slushie.make_ahead: Slush base freezes up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Stir the lemon juice, sugar syrup and water together and pour into a shallow tray.
Freeze for 3 hours, scraping with a fork every hour into a slush.
Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes to frost.
Spoon the slush into the frosted glasses and top each with ice-cold alcohol-free lager.

Raider's rib eye.make_ahead: Dry-brine the steaks the night before

steps.text: The night before, salt the rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry-brine. Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before cooking.
Sear the steaks hard in the neutral oil in a very hot pan on both sides.
Add the butter and rosemary and baste the steaks. Rest on a plate for 8 minutes.
In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add a splash of the stock and scrape up the browned bits.
Add the rest of the stock and the cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.
Pour the sauce over the rested steaks.

Old fashioned.make_ahead: Steep and chill the smoky tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; stir each drink over ice to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, squeeze them out and cool the tea completely.
For each drink, stir 60ml of the cold tea, 10ml demerara syrup, a drop of vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice for about 30 seconds.
Strain over one big ice cube in a short glass and twist a fresh strip of orange peel over the top.

Prom night pasta.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the garlic and chilli in the oil. Add the tomatoes, water and lemon juice and simmer.
Stir in the cream until the sauce turns rosy. Meanwhile cook the penne in salted water until al dente.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and finish with parmesan and basil.
Blend the pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice and a big handful of ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve straight away.

Flight 209 espresso martini.make_ahead: Brew and cool the espresso up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with the cold brew to order

steps.text: Brew the espresso and cool.
Shake the espresso, cold brew, syrup and vanilla with ice very hard to build the foam.
Strain into chilled coupes and float coffee beans on top.
Blend the ice cream with the milk and chocolate syrup until thick.
Pour into glasses and top each with a mint sprig.

Pandora blue lagoon.make_ahead: Mix the coconut water and pineapple juice up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add ice and the curacao syrup to serve

steps.text: Fill four glasses with ice.
Pour in coconut water and pineapple juice.
Add a splash of blue curacao syrup to each.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge.

Applied Sciences elderflower gin collins.make_ahead: Mix the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice in a jug up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; slice the cucumber ribbons up to 4 hours ahead, then shake over ice and top with soda water to order

steps.text: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and 2 thin cucumber ribbons each.
Shake the non-alcoholic gin, cordial and lemon juice with ice and strain evenly into the glasses.
Top with soda water, stir once and add a mint sprig.

Axel's Beverly Palm piña colada.make_ahead: Mix the pineapple juice, coconut cream and lime juice in a jug up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; blend with the ice to order

steps.text: Blend the pineapple juice, coconut cream, lime juice and ice until thick and smooth.
Pour into tall glasses.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

Freedom heather honey whisky toddy.make_ahead: Stud the lemon wheels with the cloves up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; steep the tea and top up the glasses just before serving

steps.text: Stud the lemon wheels with the cloves.
Steep the tea bags in the just-boiled water for 3 minutes, then lift out.
Into four heatproof glasses put the honey and lemon juice.
Top with the hot tea and stir until the honey dissolves. Add a studded lemon wheel and a cinnamon stick to each.

Smithsonian cherry lime phosphate.make_ahead: Syrup up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the cherries with the sugar and water, then mash well.
Strain and cool the syrup completely.
Fill tall glasses with crushed ice and add the cherry syrup, lime juice and a drop of vanilla to each.
Top with soda water, stir once and garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.
Slice one orange and cut the other into four slices for serving.
Warm the grape juice with the sliced orange, tea bag, cinnamon sticks, star anise, cloves and honey over low heat without letting it boil, lifting out the tea bag after 5 minutes.
Strain into small heatproof glasses and add a fresh orange slice to each.

Sister Margaret's margarita.make_ahead: Juice the limes and oranges up to 1 day ahead, chilled; salt the rims, shake to order and add the soda water last

steps.text: Salt the rims of four glasses.
Shake the lime juice, orange juice and agave syrup hard with ice.
Strain into the glasses and top each with a splash of soda water.

Pops's rye and ginger highball.make_ahead: Steep and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build over ice and top with ginger ale to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out and cool the tea.
Fill tall glasses with ice and pour the cold tea into each.
Add a squeeze of lime and a drop of vanilla.
Top with ginger ale, stir once gently and garnish with a lime wedge.

Easter bonnet pink fizz punch.make_ahead: Base up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the strawberries.
In a punch bowl, mix the cranberry juice, grapefruit juice and strawberries.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Add plenty of ice.
Top the grown-ups' glasses with alcohol-free sparkling wine and the kids' with lemonade.
Garnish each glass with a strawberry on the rim.

Raspberry sparkler.make_ahead: Crush and strain the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; top with cold sparkling apple juice at the table

steps.text: Crush most of the raspberries, keeping four whole, with sugar and lemon juice, then push through a sieve.
Spoon puree into each of four flutes.
Slowly top with cold sparkling apple juice, letting the foam settle.
Drop a whole raspberry into each glass.

Gareth's waistcoat elderflower fizz.make_ahead: Chill the sparkling wine up to 1 day ahead and curl the cucumber ribbons up to 3 hours ahead; top up to serve

steps.text: Peel the cucumber into long ribbons and curl one into each of four glasses.
Add cordial and a squeeze of lemon to each.
Top slowly with cold alcohol-free sparkling wine.

Alpha poolside spiked kombucha.make_ahead: Best poured just before serving to keep the fizz; chill the kombucha and ginger beer the day before

steps.text: Fill the tall glasses with ice, mint leaves and a squeeze of lime.
Pour the cold ginger kombucha into each and top with a splash of ginger beer for extra bite.
Stir once and serve straight away.

Happy place lemon shandy pitchers.make_ahead: Chill the jugs in the freezer up to 1 day ahead and stir the lemon juice and syrup together up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add soda water and alcohol-free lager to serve

steps.text: Chill two big jugs in the freezer.
Stir the juice of three lemons with the sugar syrup and soda water.
Pour half the alcohol-free lager into each jug down the side, then top each with half the lemon soda.
Add lemon wheels and pour into chilled glasses.

Funeral reception lasagne.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mince.
Simmer with tomatoes and beef stock.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, bechamel, lasagne sheets and mozzarella.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.

Long-haul espresso martini.make_ahead: Brew the espresso and stir in the sugar syrup and vanilla up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with ice to order

steps.text: Brew the espresso and let it cool slightly.
Shake the espresso, sugar syrup and vanilla very hard with ice until frothy, in batches.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Float three coffee beans on the foam of each.
Simmer the honey, water and ginger, then strain and cool.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, squeeze out and cool the tea.
Shake 200ml of the cold tea, the lemon juice and the syrup with ice.
Strain into four tumblers over one large cube each.
Float a spoonful of the remaining smoky tea on each and garnish with candied ginger.

Knock-off lager michelada.make_ahead: Mix the lime juice, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; rim the glasses and add ice and alcohol-free lager to serve

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a plate.
Rub the rims of 4 pot glasses with lime and dip in the salt.
Add ice, lime juice, tomato juice, Worcestershire and hot sauce to each glass.
Top slowly with alcohol-free lager, stir once and add a lime wedge.

Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy.n: Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy (alcohol-free)
Roger's ginger and lime lager shandy.make_ahead: Squeeze the limes and chill the alcohol-free lager and ginger beer up to 1 day ahead; build over ice to order

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice and squeeze lime into each.
Pour in the alcohol-free lager, top with ginger beer and stir gently once.
Garnish with a lime wheel and mint and serve straight away.

Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch.n: Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch (alcohol-free)
Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch.make_ahead: Steep and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in a covered jar in the fridge; juice the limes up to 1 day ahead. Build each glass to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out, stir in the molasses and vanilla and cool.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add the spiced tea and lime juice to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Pour one extra small shot of the spiced tea into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone drinks.

Ratso's Florida coconut pineapple cooler.make_ahead: Mix a jug without ice up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Juice the limes and cut a pineapple wedge for each glass.
Shake the coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice and coconut cream with ice until frothy. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and garnish with pineapple and a lime wheel.
Steep the tea bag in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out and cool.
Slice the orange, lemon and apple into a big jug.
Add the grape juice, cooled tea, sugar and cinnamon stick and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Chill for an hour.
Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the sangria with some fruit and top with a splash of lemonade.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk, cream, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.
Strain and chill.
Pour into glasses and grate fresh nutmeg over the top.

Night-watch espresso martinis.make_ahead: Brew and chill the espresso up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; shake with the syrup and ice to order

steps.text: Make the espresso and cool for 5 minutes.
For each drink, measure 1 and a half shots espresso coffee, 10ml sugar syrup and a couple of drops of vanilla into a shaker.
Shake half the batch at a time with plenty of ice for 20 seconds until frothy.
Strain into chilled coupes and repeat. Float coffee beans on each.

Pirate's rum punch.make_ahead: Steep and cool the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; mix the punch up to 1 day ahead and pour over ice

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out, stir in the molasses and vanilla and cool.
Mix the lime juice, syrup, spiced tea, pineapple juice and orange juice in a jug.
Pour over ice and grate nutmeg on top.

Parlour brandy milk punch.make_ahead: Mix the milk, syrup, vanilla and cinnamon up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with ice to order

steps.text: Shake each drink with milk, syrup, vanilla, cinnamon and ice for 15 seconds
Strain into small glasses over a large ice cube
Grate nutmeg over the top

Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler.n: Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the cranberries with the water and honey, crushing the berries.
Strain, add the juice of one lemon and chill the mors.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add mors to each, top with soda water and stir.
Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.

Bramford welcome canapés.make_ahead: Pate sets 4 hours, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Sear the livers in some butter until pink inside
Pour in the apple juice and let it bubble away
Blitz with the soft butter and thyme
Set in a dish and chill
Slice and toast the baguette and spread with pate and a little fig jam

Woodsboro house party punch.make_ahead: Stir the juices and lime juice together and chill in the punch bowl up to 1 day ahead; add the lemonade, ice and orange just before serving

steps.text: Stir the juices and lime juice together in a big punch bowl
Chill
Just before serving add the lemonade, ice and orange slices
Ladle into party cups

Smoke and Stack's Irish stout.make_ahead: Keep the cans in the fridge up to 2 days ahead so they pour cold; nothing else to prepare

steps.text: Tilt each glass and pour the stout three-quarters full
Let it settle for a minute, then top up slowly for a tight head. Allow 2 cans per person

Bourbon Manhattans.make_ahead: Mix a jug ahead, strain over ice per glass

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, squeeze out and cool the tea.
Stir 240ml of the cold tea with the cherry juice, maple syrup, a drop of vanilla and a strip of orange zest over ice in a jug.
Strain into chilled glasses.
Drop a cherry into each glass.

Elsinore maple lager shandy.make_ahead: Stir the maple lemon mix up to 2 days ahead and chill; chill the glasses and alcohol-free lager, then pour to order

steps.text: Stir the maple syrup with the juice of two lemons in a jug. Chill the beer glasses.
Pour a spoonful of the maple lemon mix into each glass and half fill with cold alcohol-free lager.
Top with lemonade, pouring slowly down the side to keep the head. Add a lemon wedge.

Bernadette's pink champagne bellini.make_ahead: Purée up to 1 day, top with sparkling just before serving

steps.text: Blend most of the raspberries with the peach and sugar syrup until smooth, then strain.
Spoon the purée into four chilled flutes.
Top slowly with cold alcohol-free sparkling rosé, stir once gently and drop in a raspberry.
Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer.
Pull the espresso and let it cool.
Shake the espresso, syrup and vanilla hard over ice so it foams, one drink at a time.
Strain into a chilled coupe and float 3 coffee beans on the crema.

Teatro Massimo limoncello spritz.make_ahead: Simmer and cool the lemon syrup up to 3 days ahead in the fridge, and chill the sparkling wine and soda; build over ice just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the sugar and water with the zest of two lemons until dissolved, cool, then stir in the juice of two lemons.
Fill four large wine glasses with ice.
Pour the lemon syrup into each, top with sparkling wine and soda and stir once gently.
Peel a wide strip of zest from the last lemon for each glass, twist over the drink and drop in. Finish with mint.
For each drink, cut half a lime into wedges and muddle hard in a glass with the sugar.
Fill with crushed ice, add half the guarana soda and stir well.
Top with the rest of the cold guarana soda and stir once more.

Gator's whiskey sour.make_ahead: Steep and chill the vanilla tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and squeeze the lemons the day before; shake each drink to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out and cool the tea.
For each drink, put 50ml of the cold tea, a drop of vanilla, the lemon juice, the sugar syrup and a little egg white in a shaker.
Shake without ice for 10 seconds to build the foam, then add ice and shake hard for 10 seconds more.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass and add a cherry.

Martini.make_ahead: Freeze the glasses up to 1 day ahead; stir the drinks over ice in two batches just before serving

steps.text: Freeze four martini glasses.
Working in two batches, stir the non-alcoholic gin and verjuice with ice.
Strain equally into the frozen glasses.
Express the lemon twist oils over each drink and garnish.

Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre.n: Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre (alcohol-free)
Tech Noir dark rum Cuba libre.make_ahead: Cut the limes up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; build the drinks over ice just before serving

steps.text: Cut the limes into quarters.
Fill four highball glasses with ice and squeeze two lime quarters into each, dropping the shells in.
Add a drop of vanilla to each glass, top with cold cola and stir once.

A plethora of margaritas.make_ahead: Juice the limes and mix the lime juice, orange juice and agave up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; shake with ice to order and top with soda water

steps.text: Juice the limes and rim four glasses with a lime wedge and salt.
Shake the lime juice, orange juice and agave syrup with ice in batches, one drink at a time.
Strain into the glasses over fresh ice and top with a splash of soda water.

Penny's Hard Deck bourbon smash.make_ahead: Brew and cool the tea up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; muddle and shake each drink to order

ingredients.item: mint leaves, plus sprigs to serve

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out, add the vanilla and cool.
For each drink muddle lemon wedges with sugar syrup and mint in a shaker.
Add 60ml of the cold tea and ice, shake hard and pour everything into a tumbler.
Top with crushed ice and add a big sprig of mint.

Turner's tidy blood orange mimosa.make_ahead: Squeeze and chill the juice up to 1 day ahead; pour and top with alcohol-free sparkling wine just before serving

steps.text: Squeeze the oranges and strain the juice into a jug.
Chill the juice.
Pour juice into chilled flutes, tilting the glass, then top slowly with alcohol-free sparkling wine.
Garnish with a thin twist of orange peel.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar.
Heat the milk, cream, cinnamon stick and vanilla until steaming, whisk into the yolks and return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it coats a spoon.
Chill.
Serve with grated nutmeg.

Frau Blücher's brandy milk punch.make_ahead: Warm the milk with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat, whisk and pour

steps.text: Warm the milk with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming without boiling
Rest and remove the cinnamon
Whisk hard until frothy
Pour into mugs and grate over a little nutmeg
